value.body: A bilingual process associate handles customer support or back-office tasks in a foreign language, usually for overseas customers of a global company. BPO/KPO firms and shared-service centres in large cities hire for these language processes, often in shifts that match the customers' time zone.

items.label: Typical entry
items.value: Any degree plus certified language proficiency
items.note: Often CEFR B2 or JLPT N3 and above

items.label: Common tools
items.value: CRM and ticketing systems, email, chat tools

value.title: How you get in
value.body: Apply to language processes at BPO/KPO and shared-service companies; selection is usually a language test, a typing or comprehension test, and an interview conducted partly in the language.

value.title: Skills you'll use
items: Reading and writing in the language
Typing speed and comfort with ticketing tools

value.title: At a glance
items: This is the most common entry job for foreign-language graduates.
Night or rotating shifts are common for European and American processes.
Growth paths lead to team lead, quality analyst, trainer or translation roles.
